content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate chip cookie, reduced sugar is a soft, slightly crunchy cookie made with whole‑grain flour, a modest amount of natural sweeteners, and dark chocolate chips. It retains the classic chocolate chip flavor while containing about 30 % less sugar than traditional versions.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cookie uses whole‑grain flour, increasing its dietary fiber content.
Sweetness comes from stevia and erythritol, which have minimal impact on blood glucose.
Chocolate chips are made from dark chocolate with at least 70 % cocoa solids.
The recipe was developed with nutritionists to lower the glycemic index.
No artificial colors or flavors are added.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain flour provides dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Reduced sugar and natural sweeteners help maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Antioxidants from dark chocolate
items.content: Dark chocolate is rich in flavonoids, which may benefit cardiovascular health.

items.title: Source of magnesium and iron
items.content: Whole‑grain ingredients supply minerals important for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Moderate fat content
items.content: Fats come mainly from chocolate and plant oils, making them healthier than in many conventional cookies.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The cookie contains wheat flour and is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Chocolate allergy
items.content: Dark chocolate may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to cocoa.

items.title: Still contains sweeteners
items.content: Although sugar is reduced, the product still includes sweeteners, which may be undesirable on a strict sugar‑free diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the cookie as a snack, crumble it over yogurt or ice cream, or incorporate it into dessert recipes such as layered cakes. Keep it in a dry place to preserve its crisp texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for 1‑2 weeks. For longer shelf life, refrigerate them, where they stay fresh for up to 1 month.
